name: mstest-extensions
description: Opinionated native MSTest testing and extensions: MSTest.Sdk 4.5.1, Microsoft.Testing.Platform 2.5.1, AllMicrosoft extensions and native Microsoft code coverage. Use native context, lifecycle, data rows and composition without VSTest or legacy compatibility shims.

interface.longDescription: Build and verify tests and reusable extensions with MSTest.Sdk 4.5.1 / MSTest 4.5.1, Microsoft.Testing.Platform 2.5.1, TestingExtensionsProfile=AllMicrosoft and native Microsoft code coverage. Prefer SDK-owned runner registration and lifecycle, native invocation context and data rows, typed selectors and named contract constants. No VSTest or older-version fallback. Native AOT is a separate published-artifact verification path.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the MSTest Extensions skill to implement and verify a testing capability in this project's installed MSTest version.

publication.release_notes: Own the MSTest API and assertion skills, including their generated catalog, examples and verification; distinguish API lookup, test implementation and assertion review.
